description: This file defines a singleton helper class 'RefreshBroadcast' that manages event notification for refresh requests within the BlazorAdmin application, providing a thread-safe singleton pattern and an event to signal refresh operations.

classes.name: RefreshBroadcast
classes.description: A singleton class that provides an event-based mechanism to broadcast refresh requests within the application.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of RefreshBroadcast.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Raises the RefreshRequested event to notify subscribers to refresh.
